scope: read-only CPU replay of saved scalar row losses through captured pure policy class; no training, inference, model evaluation, profiling, GPU inspection or queue actions

rules.threshold: T=min(1.5,max(.3,10*uppermedian(previous kept loss history))); no-history fallback1.5
rules.gate: sticky; current16 uppermedian sorted[8]<.5; applies same step
rules.sequential: after each kept row append to recent history; masked rows excluded; prune step window only after the16th row with s>step-20
rules.budget: last<=10 high flags, len>=4 and high fraction>=.5 => high row exempt; require_known=False
rules.floor_binding: 10*median<.3; floor raises threshold, cannot itself add a mask under frozen history
rules.cap_binding: max(.3,10*median)>1.5; binding alone is not a causal extra deletion
rules.cap_extra_mask: gate open, not budget exempt, loss in(1.5,uncapped threshold] => actual mask but frozen-history no-cap keep
rules.floor_protection: gate open, not budget exempt, loss in(no-floor threshold,.3] => actual keep but frozen-history no-floor mask
rules.reference_all_rows: same historical time window and within-step prefix, but includes already consumed masked rows; uses actual fixed flags; a selection accounting contrast
rules.region_equality: strict binding; ties exactly at .3/1.5 assigned middle, fallback separately

replay_method: AST-extract exact unmodified ContradictionMaskPolicy class; shadow_m=() omits observers that never feed decisions; wrap threshold only to record pre-decision state; keep_mask itself performs every state update. Match gate, all masked tuples and scalar losses, high-budget and unknown counters, and n_groups exactly.

budget.warning: high flags are loss-threshold events, not proof of forgetting or new knowledge

causal_limits: Every counterfactual preserves recorded losses and actual pre-row history/flags. It changes only the current decision; decisions are not propagated to future history, gradients, weights, losses or ASR.
Exact replay establishes implementation-level accounting, not a matched training ablation or a claim that thresholds cause endpoint quality or ASR.
Threshold regimes differ across tasks/models/data and cannot isolate floor/cap from their loss trajectories or metadata repetition.
Captured current source is not an immutable source pin at original run time, but exact match across complete saved decision outputs and counters strongly validates replay on these traces.
Group budget is based on recurring high-loss flags; an exemption does not establish new knowledge, forgetting, or poison safety.
A threshold at floor is the setting of a clipping branch, not evidence that the floor caused deletions. Removing the floor weakly lowers the threshold and can add masks under frozen state.
